subject: Request to approve opening: on-call inference backfill + interview slate
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-19T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: open backfill for on-call inference engineer (need approval + slate)

Hi Jordan —

Following up from last week's note: Anirudh resigned effective 12/31 and we need to open a backfill for the On-call Inference Engineer role (infra/runtime team). I've attached the updated JD and a short hiring plan. Key asks:

- Can you approve opening the req in Greenhouse and authorize scheduling of interviews this week?
- We need a 3-interviewer panel (tech, infra reliability, and on-call owner) plus a short take-home.
- Target window: first onsites week of Jan 4 (candidate start target late Jan/Feb).

I've flagged two constraints from infra: must have rust/C++ baseline + prior ops on GPU infra. I copied Mina for panel coordination and Marissa for budget approval.

Attachments: JD_Oncall_Inference_Eng_v2.pdf, panel_readiness_checklist.xlsx

Next steps I propose: you + Marissa sign off on opening; Mina coordinates with recruiting to schedule 2 initial screens next week.

Thanks —
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Hiring Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-19T11:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: open backfill for on-call inference engineer (need approval + slate)

Thanks Neha — quick clarifying questions before I sign off:

1) Interview slate: can you confirm the names for the proposed panel? I want to avoid last-minute conflicts over holidays.
2) Compensation band: is this aligned with the current infra IC3 band we used for the last hire?
3) Take-home: how long and what scope? We should be explicit so recruiting can set expectations.

If the slate is small (3 folks) and comp band matches IC3, I can greenlight opening the req today. Mina — can you draft two available interview slots (week of Jan 4) and paste them into the GH req?

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Director, Infrastructure Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Talently Recruiting <recruiting@talently.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-19T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: open backfill for on-call inference engineer (need approval + slate)

Hi Jordan / Neha / Mina —

Thanks — we got this. Quick update and candidate slate:

1) Candidate A: Emily Nguyen (resume attached: resume_emily_nguyen.pdf). Senior SRE with 4 years GPU infra experience; meets Rust baseline.
2) Candidate B: Javier Torres (external email j.torres@beamcloud.io) — scheduling conflict over holidays but available Jan 6 onward.

We created a Greenhouse req (RED-1452) and added the JD and panel_readiness_checklist link. Proposed live interview blocks for week of Jan 4:
- Tue Jan 5: 10:00-11:30 PT (screen + tech deep dive)
- Thu Jan 7: 13:00-15:00 PT (panel + take-home review)

Take-home suggestion: 3 small tasks (max 3 hours) focusing on kernel-level debugging and a short ops runbook exercise. We can set pass/fail + rubric.

Attachments: resume_emily_nguyen.pdf

Next: Jordan / Marissa to confirm opening and comp band; Mina to confirm panelers or propose alternates. Recruiting will hold the candidate slots until EOD Monday.

Best —
Priya Sharma
Talently Recruiting (on behalf of Redwood)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-12-20T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: open backfill for on-call inference engineer (need approval + slate)

Jordan / Neha —

Approved to open the req (RED-1452) and proceed with scheduling. Compensation band: confirm IC3 band applies; if candidate requests exceed band, route to me and finance for exception.

Mina — please lock the Jan 5/Jan 7 slots and confirm the panel:
- Tech interview: Mina Haddad
- Infra reliability: Samir Patel (I asked him to tentatively hold the slot)
- On-call owner: Neha Kapoor

Recruiting — hold Emily's slot; if she accepts a screen, prioritize Jan 5.

Also: keep the take-home to <=3 hours and make scoring binary with clear rubric; we want to move quickly on on-call hires.

Marissa Cole
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference
